Embedded Controls Software Engineer
Detroit, MI (on-site)

The role:
Develop embedded control software for heavy-duty powertrain control units.

Responsibilities:
- Develop Transmission Control Unit (TCU) application software.
- Implement shift control and real-time control logic in C/C++.
- Build MATLAB/Simulink models and validate on Hardware-in-the-Loop benches.
- Support dynamometer and vehicle testing campaigns.

Requirements:
- Strong C++ and embedded control experience.
- MISRA C and AUTOSAR familiarity.
- Hands-on with CAN, CAN-FD, and UDS diagnostics.
- Model-based development in MATLAB/Simulink.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with control systems and plant modeling.
- Exposure to functional safety (ISO 26262).
